title: Slaunt - The Best Way to Cowork with AI
excerpt: All-in-one agentic AI solution for organizational memory and work intelligence.
content_html:
Deploy Claude Code safely

Slaunt gives agents context and controls what they can see, so your team can deploy code with confidence.

Built with security from the ground up

Your data is encrypted, never used to train AI models, and protected by independently audited controls.

Full audit trail

Every agent action is recorded to an immutable, queryable log — so you can see exactly what ran, when, and why.

Least-privilege access

Every agent runs with scoped, tenant-isolated permissions — you decide exactly what each one can see, write, and run.

No training on your data

Your workspace data is never used to train models.

Jakob asked to hold off until legal approves. Continue anyway?

HoldContinue

slaunt — issue #204

OAuth not logging data to Sentry

Open

Kerode M.Opened May 20BugCriticalLoginTelemetry

Problem

OAuth failures happen without enough observability. When a user fails to authenticate we don't reliably get Sentry events with provider, callback route, error type, or request state — so auth failures look like silent failures during onboarding and demos.

Agent notes

Inspect the OAuth callback handler, current Sentry setup, environment config, and error boundaries. Prioritize safe observability over verbose logging.

Done when

  • Callback failures appear in Sentry
  • Token exchange errors appear in Sentry
  • Events include provider, route, and sanitized error type
